title: Verificación: MLX DeepSeek V4 Flash long-context benchmarks show low KV usage but still significant on consumer GPUs
summary: Claim revisado: MLX Q2 version of DeepSeek V4 Flash has 'unbelievably low' memory usage up to 256K context (detailed table: 158.5GB total / 1.76GB KV at 256K on M3 Ultra). Evidencia: Reply highlighting that even the 'low' 119GB+ KV cache at high context 'makes my consumer GPU weep'. Notes every token needs memory bandwidth seat.. Caveat editorial: Impressive relative numbers on high-RAM Apple Silicon (512GB) do not translate directly to typical consumer GPUs (24-48GB VRAM); KV cache remains a hard limit for long context.. Reproducibilidad: high - references the full benchmark table (pp/tg speeds, mem, KV GB, batch TPS, perplexity) with exact quant and hardware.
